statement: Pinned Dolphin Real Wii Remote HIDAPI scanner enumerates all VID/PIDs, filters for a valid Wii Remote name or known ID and an unseen path, then attempts a temporary hid_open_path and writes a status-request output report as a usability probe before adding the device. It closes the temporary handle and only then can create a real-Wiimote transport object; subsequent actual Connect opens it again. Consequently an owned hidraw FD being open in a separate tool does not prove Dolphin scanner accepted the device, passed the status write, assigned an available real-remote slot or added ControllerInterface input. This extends existing Dolphin binding/calibration claims without asserting why W5's Flatpak direct backend did not connect.
